		if = {
			limit = { has_building = war_storage_5 }
			aub_pay_gold_prestige_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = regular_building_cost_tier_5 PRESTIGE = tribal_building_prestige_cost_tier_5 }
		}
	}
}

# warhorse_training_1: 4 frozen upgrade edge(s)
